purpose: Fresh synthetic US gastroenterology documents for verifying the deployed CPT Studio flow: automatic routing, exact evidence, clarification, review decisions, reload persistence and the downloaded reports.
banner: SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
author_expectations: author_expected_cpt is the document author's expectation, written while authoring these documents. It is NOT independent adjudication, it is never asserted by the verifiers, and it must not be used as accuracy evidence. Accuracy needs independently adjudicated cases withheld from development (ARCHITECTURE.md section 9).

review_notes.reject: Agent-executed synthetic verification review - designated rejection exercising the reject path; not a clinical judgement

semantics.upload.service_date: null: the verifier clears the service-date field so the date documented in the note is used.
semantics.expected_extraction: status_in / method_in against revision.extraction; ocr_pages_nonempty requires OCR to have run; text_matches_source 'exact' compares revision.text with the source (trailing whitespace ignored, hard), 'whitespace' compares after collapsing whitespace (soft).
semantics.expected_context: per context fact: origin_in and optional value_in (values use the API vocabulary).
semantics.expected_routing.families: presence 'required' fails when routing does not report the family; 'optional' checks the family only when reported. status_in is the aggregated family status. facts.<name>.value_contains_any is a case-insensitive substring test on a fact reported with origin 'document'. missing_includes / missing_excludes test the family's missing required facts. 'informational' expectations are reported as warnings only.
semantics.expected_routing.not_performed: families that, when reported, must have no performed or incomplete status, neither aggregated nor on any mention.
semantics.expected_clarifications: facts that must have an OPEN clarification, with an optional scope_in.
semantics.must_not_code: families that must have no READY selected proposal (a selected proposal there that is not excluded is reported as a warning).
semantics.incomplete_services: families documented as incomplete: never silently dropped, and never presented as a ready code without an incompleteness signal (a non-pass check, a 52/53/incomplete modifier consideration, or needs_clarification).
semantics.review_plan.reject: the ready selected proposal to reject instead of approve: the first in the family whose code is in prefer_codes, otherwise the last ready selected proposal in the family. Every other ready selected proposal is approved.
